test.name: Verify AV Playback on LiveTV

kw.name: Start Recording
kw.doc: Triggers the video and audio recording.

kw.name: Begin Telnet Logging
kw.doc: Starts telnet connection on port 19690 and starts saving the logs in a usb
kw.msg: Connecting to 192.168.153.23:19690 Logs started Logs stored in: F:\Logs\192.168.153.23_2026-07-27_10-54-30

kw.name: Press Back
kw.doc: Sends keyevent KEYCODE_BACK "n" number of times through IR.

kw.name: Sleep
kw.doc: Pauses the test executed for the given time.

kw.name: Take Screenshot
kw.doc: Takes and screenshot.

kw.name: Sleep
kw.doc: Pauses the test executed for the given time.

kw.name: Crop Picture And Apply Inverse Color
kw.doc: Crops and inverse color for a picture with the given coordinates.

kw.name: Sleep
kw.doc: Pauses the test executed for the given time.

kw.name: Get Txt From Img
kw.doc: OCR gets the text found in a picture.

kw.name: Get Current Date
kw.doc: Returns current local or UTC time with an optional increment.

kw.name: Create File
kw.doc: Creates a file with the given content and encoding.

kw.name: Create Json
kw.doc: Creates a JSON file containing the datails required to post the test results on devices with not ADB

kw.name: Press Back
kw.doc: Sends keyevent KEYCODE_BACK "n" number of times through IR.

kw.name: Sleep
kw.doc: Pauses the test executed for the given time.

kw.name: Press Vol Up
kw.doc: Sends keyevent KEYCODE_VOLUME_UP "n" number of times through IR.

kw.name: Wait Pixel V3
kw.doc: Waits until a defined pixel gets the given RGB values within a timeout.

kw.name: Sleep
kw.doc: Pauses the test executed for the given time.

kw.name: Wait Pixel V3
kw.doc: Waits until a defined pixel gets the given RGB values within a timeout.

kw.name: Should Be True
kw.doc: Fails if the given condition is not true.

kw.name: Video Detection
kw.doc: Verifies if there is video playback by taking samples of hash values from different frames.

kw.name: Should Be True
kw.doc: Fails if the given condition is not true.

kw.name: Record Audio
kw.doc: Record an audio stream as output.wav

kw.name: Audio Detection
kw.doc: Verifies if there is audio in the output.wav file.

kw.name: Should Be True
kw.doc: Fails if the given condition is not true.

kw.name: Stop Recording
kw.doc: Stops the video and audio recording.

kw.name: Stream Telnet Logs
kw.doc: stream the logs in the terminal
